name: agent-config
title: Agent configuration
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Configure CRM agents: example models, confidence bands, declarative guardrails, and draft versus published versions.

meta.descriptionEs: Configura los agentes de un CRM: modelos de ejemplo, bandas de confianza, guardas declarativas y borrador contra la versión publicada.

examples.title: Consola de Nimbo
examples.description: Seis agentes de ejemplo, bandas editables y una publicación que puede fallar.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cuarenta agentes, nombres largos, bandas extremas, vacío y solo lectura.

meta.usage: <AgentConfig workspace={workspace} agents={agents} versions={versions} models={models} guardrailTypes={types} onSaveDraft={save} onPublishRequest={publish} onRollbackRequest={rollback} slots={{ navigation, usageCost, modelSelect }} />

api.name: agents / versions
api.description: Agents plus draft and published versions. Version state is draft or published.

api.name: models / guardrailTypes
api.description: Example models (per 1M, converted to amountPer1k) and the host's guardrail catalog. Unknown rules do not run.

api.name: onSaveDraft / onPublishRequest / onRollbackRequest
api.description: Host callbacks. The screen rolls back if the promise rejects.

api.name: runTest
api.description: Host port for a test prompt. The default is a deterministic simulator.

api.name: slots
api.description: navigation, usageCost (cost-waterfall), modelSelect and fallbackSelect (model-router subset).

api.name: locale / labels / readOnly / loading / error / busy
api.description: es-MX or English copy, a read-only role, and loading, error, or busy chrome.

api.name: className / classNames
api.description: Root class and slot classes. No theme tokens of its own.

docs: Clean-room de una imagen sin licencia (Jubayer, pantalla AI configuration de Axon). No hay código, datos, iconos ni assets copiados. La marca de la demo es Nimbo y los precios son de ejemplo. Si el CLI pregunta si debe sobrescribir un primitivo que el anfitrión ya tiene (alert, badge, button, card, empty, field, input, scroll-area, select, separator, skeleton, sparkline, switch, tabs, textarea), responde no. La pieza no trae tema, cssVars ni colores fijos. Uso y costo, el selector de modelo y la navegación son slots.
